title: Probability of a nonzero matrix bilinear form
statement: Let $D$ be an $n$-by-$n$ matrix over the field with two elements. The probability that its bilinear form is nonzero, when $x$ and $y$ are chosen independently and uniformly from the $n$-dimensional coordinate space over that field, is the uniform probability of the event that the form evaluated at $(x,y)$ is nonzero.
